high_level_description: A crisp editorial photograph of a yellow ceramic teapot and two pale blue cups on a light oak breakfast table, softly lit by morning window light.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A warm white plaster wall behind a pale oak tabletop, with soft morning light entering from the left and gentle shadows falling to the right.

elements.desc: One round yellow glazed ceramic teapot with a matching lid, a curved handle, and a short spout. Fine highlights describe the smooth glossy surface.
Two small pale blue ceramic cups standing together on the oak surface, their rounded rims catching the soft window light.
